reason: A plugin testing and debugging sandbox that runs isolated DeepSeek Harness web instances, mounts and builds local plugins, and exposes GUI and agent controls for lifecycle management and logs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发者提供隔离测试沙盒，可构建并挂载本地插件，并通过面板或智能体工具管理测试实例。
summaries.en: Provides isolated DeepSeek Harness test sandboxes for building and mounting local plugins, with GUI and agent controls for instance lifecycle and logs.

capabilities: Spawns isolated local web processes with separate ports and data directories
Mounts and optionally builds a locally specified plugin
Provides GUI and agent tools to start, stop, restart, inspect logs, and destroy sandboxes
Can inject host API credentials and copy host model settings when enabled
Can delete an entire sandbox directory during destruction
